meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: mTORC1 raises mitochondrial respiratory capacity through a YY1–PGC-1α transcriptional programme and through 4E-BP-dependent translation of respiratory components.
data.mechanism_beginner: mTORC1 boosts how much energy mitochondria can produce, through both gene activation and protein-building. One mouse experiment points the other way – removing mTORC1 from fat tissue RAISED respiration – so this direction is not settled in a living animal.
data.boundary: Effect size varies strongly by tissue; the transcriptional and translational arms have not been cleanly separated in vivo. OVERLAP (audit 2026-09-04): this edge and MTORC1-MITO assert overlapping biology from overlapping citations (CUN2007, MOR2013) at different tiers and different consensus levels. Read them together; they are not independent support.
